top_liked.author: @DadamWrites
top_liked.text: Awesome message - nihilists don't have to say "there is no meaning". My journey led me to realize that nihilism means we have to give ourselves meaning. And that's far better than being saddled with some perceived external goal.

top_liked.author: @lucifer-look-
top_liked.text:
It is a true magick, to become free of outer meaning and to finally lift head and see own reasons to live this life.

Nihilism gives us a freedom to determine reason and to understand it's value

top_liked.author: @lhvinny
top_liked.text: Why is this a message for atheists?

top_liked.author: @rawbebaba
top_liked.text:
Idk I think atheism is kinda dumb, there's no battle. You aren't fighting religion your fighting power and those that wield it. Just because people like to attach a god head to their policies or decisions that's just to smuggle in authority. 

We really have to be careful…
